_note: Featured/Hero tuning. Every key is optional: an absent or misspelled key falls back to the default in scanner/movie_featured.py rather than to zero, so one weight can be changed without restating the document. slots is clamped to maximum_slots.
_exclude_note: A title the lifecycle is only republishing under grace has not been confirmed playable recently, so it is not auto-promoted to the Hero. A manual pin still overrides this and is flagged in the output.
_curated_note: Ids of a real editorial collection, if one ever exists. Empty means there is none - it is not a place to hand-pick the Hero, which is what state/manual-featured.json is for.
_weights_note: Out of 100. available_link_count is NOT a weight: it contributes at most a tenth of the playback weight as a tie-break and can never reorder a real trend.
